name: Komatsu Rina
source: Childhood friend of [url=/c22455]Sekiya Akito[/url] and [url=/c22451]Hoshino Nagisa[/url]. She skillfully maintains a balance in their relationship. She is a member of the swimming club at Keisen Academy, but not particularly enthusiastic about it; mainly using it as a means to stay in shape.
translation: [url=/c22455]关谷明人[/url]和[url=/c22451]星野渚[/url]的青梅竹马，擅长维持两人关系的平衡。她是庆泉学园游泳部成员，却对游泳并不热心，主要把游泳当作保持身材的手段。
